_comment: Per-string context pushed to Crowdin by `npm run i18n:context`. One line per key saying where the string appears and what constrains it — the facts a translator cannot get from the English alone. Written when the string is, by whoever ran /wording. Keys mirror en.json.
title: Screen title. One line. Should match main_menu.load_game.
tabs.recent: Left tab under the screen title, selected by default: games still in play plus the two most recently finished. One or two words; pairs with tabs.archive.
tabs.archive: Right tab under the screen title: every finished investigation. One word if possible — a closed case, matching `completed`.
opened: Metadata line on a case file card. {{date}} is already formatted for the locale.
last_played: Metadata line on a case file card. {{date}} is already formatted for the locale.
completed: Replaces last_played on the card of a finished investigation; pairs with `opened` as the case file's two dates. {{date}} is date-only, already formatted for the locale.
empty.message: Shown when the reader has no games yet. Two lines: the `\n` is deliberate. Atmospheric but must still say plainly that the list is empty.
empty.action: Button under the empty state, starts a new game.
archive_empty.message: Shown on the closed-cases tab when no investigation has finished yet. Two lines: the `\n` is deliberate. No button under it. The first line must say plainly that nothing is here; the second hints, without naming it, that some cases never end.
error.title: Heading when either tab's list fails to load. Atmospheric — dread in the heading. One line.
error.message: Body under that heading. Plain: what happened, in the reader's terms.
error.retry: Button beside that message. Two words at most.
back: Button returning to the main menu. One word if your language allows.
